hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Because the score formula is cyclic, rotating any permutation preserves its total cost. Fix perm[0] = 0 to break cyclic symmetry.

hints.title: Bitmask State
hints.text: Define state (last, mask) where last is the most recently chosen element and mask represents the subset of selected elements.

hints.title: Reconstruction
hints.text: Iterate over unvisited elements in ascending order to find optimal successor transitions, then reconstruct the lexicographically smallest optimal permutation.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: length of array nums (at most 14)
complexity.notes: Bitmask traveling salesperson formulation with path reconstruction.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all n! permutations directly is impossible for n up to 14.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Fix the initial element to zero due to cyclic invariance and apply bitmask dynamic programming.
